s: Zion is seen eye to eye by the watchmen of Zion (when the Lord brings again Zion)
q: Yea, Lord, thy watchmen shall lift up their voice; with the voice together shall they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.

s: the watchmen of Zion lift up peace (with the voice together shall they sing)
q: Yea, Lord, thy watchmen shall lift up their voice; with the voice together shall they sing

s: Jerusalem is redeemed the Lord (the Lord has comforted his people)
q: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem; for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

s: God is a one God (the very Eternal Father of heaven and of earth)
q: And they are one God, yea, the very Eternal Father of heaven and of earth.

s: Christ is subject to the Father (in the flesh)
q: having subjected the flesh to the will of the Father, being the Father and the Son—

s: Christ suffers temptation (without yielding to it)
q: being one God, suffereth temptation, and yieldeth not to the temptation

s: Christ is mocked the children of men
q: but suffereth himself to be mocked, and scourged, and cast out, and disowned by his people.

s: Christ is crucified and slain the crucifixion and death of Christ (the flesh becoming subject to death)
q: Yea, even so he shall be led, crucified, and slain, the flesh becoming subject even unto death

s: Christ makes intercession for children of men (having gained victory over death)
q: giving the Son power to make intercession for the children of men—

s: Abinadi speaks about salvation
q: The time shall come when all shall see the salvation of the Lord;

s: the Fall of Adam causes carnality (among all mankind)
q: which was the cause of all mankind becoming carnal, sensual, devilish

s: all mankind is a carnal, sensual, and devilish (in the fallen state)
q: all mankind becoming carnal, sensual, devilish

s: all mankind is subject to the devil (in the fallen state)
q: subjecting themselves to the devil.

s: all mankind is lost lost (because of the fall)
q: Thus all mankind were lost;

s: God redeems all mankind (from their lost and fallen state)
q: behold, they would have been endlessly lost were it not that God redeemed his people from their lost and fallen state.

s: carnality keeps in the fallen state (those who persist in their own carnal nature)
q: he that persists in his own carnal nature, and goes on in the ways of sin and rebellion against God, remaineth in his fallen state

s: sin is a way of rebellion against God
q: goes on in the ways of sin and rebellion against God

s: salvation is seen by every nation, kindred, tongue, and people (in the future)
q: The time shall come when all shall see the salvation of the Lord; when every nation, kindred, tongue, and people shall see eye to eye

s: the devil has all power over him
q: the devil hath all power over him.

s: redemption is made possible by Christ's coming into the world (without which there could be no redemption)
q: And now if Christ had not come into the world, speaking of things to come as though they had already come, there could have been no redemption.

s: Christ is a the very Eternal Father
q: redemption cometh through Christ the Lord, who is the very Eternal Father.

s: the resurrection of the dead is made possible by Christ (through rising from the dead and breaking the bands of death)
q: And if Christ had not risen from the dead, or have broken the bands of death that the grave should have no victory, and that death should have no sting, there could have been no resurrection.

s: the resurrection of the dead exists exists
q: But there is a resurrection

s: the sting of death is swallowed up in Christ
q: and the sting of death is swallowed up in Christ.

s: Christ is a the light of the world
q: He is the light and the life of the world

s: the light of the world is endless endless (never darkened)
q: yea, a light that is endless, that can never be darkened

s: Christ is a eternal life (there can be no more death)
q: yea, and also a life which is endless, that there can be no more death.

s: all mankind puts on immortality (at the resurrection)
q: Even this mortal shall put on immortality

s: all mankind puts on incorruption (at the resurrection)
q: and this corruption shall put on incorruption

s: all mankind stands before the bar of God (to be judged)
q: and shall be brought to stand before the bar of God

s: Final Judgment is based on works (whether they are good or evil)
q: to be judged of him according to their works whether they be good or whether they be evil—

s: good leads to eternal life (at the resurrection)
q: If they be good, to the resurrection of endless life and happiness

s: evil leads to everlasting punishment (at the resurrection)
q: and if they be evil, to the resurrection of endless damnation

s: everlasting punishment delivers up to the devil
q: being delivered up to the devil, who hath subjected them, which is damnation—

s: mercy is extended to all mankind (through the arms of mercy)
q: for the arms of mercy were extended towards them

s: repentance is required for salvation (through Christ)
q: ought ye not to tremble and repent of your sins, and remember that only in and through Christ ye can be saved?

s: the law of Moses is a shadow (of things to come)
q: if ye teach the law of Moses, also teach that it is a shadow of those things which are to come—

s: redemption comes through Christ (the Lord)
q: Teach them that redemption cometh through Christ the Lord

s: the wicked is not redeemed by Lord (because they do not hearken to his voice)
q: and this because they would not hearken unto the voice of the Lord; therefore the Lord redeemeth them not.

s: the devil has power over the wicked
q: For they are carnal and devilish, and the devil has power over them;

s: that old serpent beguile the devil
q: yea, even that old serpent that did beguile our first parents

s: Abinadi is a prophet
q: And now it came to pass that when Abinadi had finished these sayings, that the king commanded that the priests should take him and cause that he should be put to death.

s: king Noah is a king
q: And now king Noah was about to release him, for he feared his word

s: king Noah commands priests of Noah (to take Abinadi and put him to death)
q: the king commanded that the priests should take him and cause that he should be put to death.

s: king Noah fears judgments of God
q: for he feared his word; for he feared that the judgments of God would come upon him.
